lanes.evidence: Left lane between the yellow median edge line/raised planted median and the solid white lane line; stop bar reaches it (C2), vehicles drive in it (C1). No arrow or word visible in it in the satellite (only a long dark shadow/wire line) or in C1/C2. Not the curbside lane (r2 is to its right), and the junction has no exit to the driver's left (north-east side is building/park), so it feeds straight ahead to out_EB only.

Right lane between the solid white lane line and the green bicycle lane. Satellite shows a right-curving arrow in r2 just upstream of the stop bar (and a second faint right arrow further upstream in shadow); C2 forward view shows the word ONLY in this lane near the stop bar, and C1 look-back shows the same ONLY (seen reversed) in the lane next to the green bike lane. Right arrow + ONLY = right-turn-only lane.

movements.reason: No exit to the driver's left of the EB approach; the overview shows a building and park on that side.
r1 is the only lane not marked RIGHT ONLY; out_EB continues straight ahead (+0 deg) with one lane.
r2 carries a right-turn arrow (satellite) and ONLY (C1, C2); out_SB lies +90 deg to the right with one lane.
No U-turn arrow or sign seen; the raised median separates the opposing carriageway and nothing marks a U-turn movement.

temporary_control.evidence: No cones, barrels or work-zone devices in r1 or r2 in C1/C2 or the satellite. An orange object lies on the median grass in C3 (101 m upstream), an orange diamond sign stands by the opposite carriageway in C1, and orange cones sit on the sidewalk by out_WB in the overview; none affects r1/r2.

notes: Bicycle lane (1.63 m, green) runs to the right of r2 to the stop bar and is not a motor lane. C3 at 101 m appears to be at an upstream crossing with chevron hatching and a green conflict zone, not at this stop bar, so it was not used for lane use. Street views 2020-11; satellite date unknown but its right arrow in r2 agrees with the street views.
